request.description:
Unsubscribe from the newsletter using token.

- No authentication required
- Token is from the unsubscribe link in emails

Unsubscribe from the newsletter via GET request (for email links).

This endpoint allows one-click unsubscribe from email links.
Format: /newsletter/unsubscribe?token=

Get subscription status by token.

Used by unsubscribe page to show current status.
